name: The Search For She-Hulk, Part 1: Hiding

synopsis.text: "THE SEARCH FOR SHE-HULK" pt. 1 (of 4) Her transformations out of control, Jennifer Walters seeks the one person on Earth who can help... while her fellow Avengers search every corner of the globe for her! Artist Scott Kolins joins the Avengers ranks for this 4-issue story arc!
